category: currency exchange rate API (fiat, 12 crypto assets and metals)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0, no card: 500 monthly requests, 10 requests a minute, 1 API key, live rates updated every 60 minutes with a fixed base currency, no historical rates.
free_tier.notes: Crypto rates for 12 assets are in the same live rates call on every plan, the free plan included. Essential is USD 9.99 a month for 20,000 requests and adds convert, history from 2000, any base currency. The pricing page and the free-API page disagree on the free plan's feature bullets, because the free-API page lost its check and cross marks in text; the pricing page and the FAQ on the free-API page both say live rates only.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 500 requests a month bound what a free key can pull

tooling: curl or any HTTP client; vendor SDKs for Python, Node.js, PHP and Go
chaining: Hourly live fiat and crypto rates at 500 a month is about 16 a day, so an hourly poll does not fit; a few polls a day do.

limits.value: 500 monthly requests on the Free plan
10 requests a minute on the Free plan

limits_note: History: none on the free plan; history from 2000 starts on Essential and the timeframe range on StartUp. Bulk path: none on the free plan.
binding_note: 500 requests a month ends first: the 10 a minute rate would spend it in 50 minutes.

identity_cost.detail: The free-API page says to sign up with an email and that no credit card is required. The form fields are unverified: no copy of the sign-up page is in the sources.

reliability_note: The docs list HTTP 429 among the error codes; the free-plan cut-off behaviour was not read.
confidence_note: Plan numbers come from the pricing page and the free-API FAQ. The sign-up form fields and the free plan's cut-off are unverified; no key was created.
